_info: Biaya ore per level peralatan hero. Common maks level 18, epic maks level 27. Total ke maks: common 27.260 Shiny + 1.920 Glowy; epic 56.060 Shiny + 3.720 Glowy + 480 Starry (1337wiki dan clashos.in).
